characteristics.name: Born With Quick Feet
characteristics.effect: AGI and COD cost 15% less during creation and future Player-XP upgrades.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Useful but not a premier QB rating pair.

characteristics.name: Naturally Fast
characteristics.effect: SPD and ACC cost 12% less during creation and future upgrades.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Speed/acceleration are extremely valuable and expensive.

characteristics.name: Explosive First Step
characteristics.effect: ACC costs 18% less during creation and future upgrades.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Narrow one-attribute discount.

characteristics.name: Natural Athlete
characteristics.effect: AGI, COD, JMP and ACC each cost 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Broad multi-rating discount.

characteristics.name: Born With an Arm
characteristics.effect: THP costs 15% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Throw power is a premium QB attribute.

characteristics.name: Natural Accuracy
characteristics.effect: SAC and MAC cost 10% less; DAC costs 6% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Touches three core passing ratings.

characteristics.name: Pocket Sense
characteristics.effect: BSK costs 15% less and TUP costs 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Improves pocket survival without raw speed.

characteristics.name: Off-Platform Thrower
characteristics.effect: TOR costs 15% less and TUP 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Specialized improvisational value.

characteristics.name: Play-Action Savant
characteristics.effect: PAC costs 18% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: One situational but useful rating.

characteristics.name: Deep Ball Artist
characteristics.effect: DAC costs 12% less and THP 6% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Cascades with Born With an Arm for vertical QBs; discount cap still applies.

characteristics.name: Rhythm Passer
characteristics.effect: SAC and MAC each cost 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Smaller accuracy discount than Natural Accuracy.

characteristics.name: Pressure Proof
characteristics.effect: TUP costs 18% less. Gold weekly challenges completed with 0 turnovers grant +1 bonus XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Premium due to attribute + XP component.

characteristics.name: Escape Artist
characteristics.effect: BSK, COD and ACC each cost 10% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Broad mobility/survival package.

characteristics.name: Designed Runner
characteristics.effect: CAR, JKM and BCV each cost 10% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Only valuable for run-heavy QBs.

characteristics.name: Ball Security
characteristics.effect: CAR costs 18% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Narrow protection against fumbles.

characteristics.name: Clutch Processor
characteristics.effect: AWR upgrades cost 10% less; playoff weekly challenge XP +20%.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Mental + postseason benefit.

characteristics.name: Command at the Line
characteristics.effect: If the player earns 120+ IQ, his first AWR upgrade each season costs 25% less XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Conditional IQ synergy keeps it from being universally optimal.

characteristics.name: Two-Minute Specialist
characteristics.effect: Weekly challenges involving completion percentage, zero turnovers, or passing TDs pay +1 XP when completed in a win, max +1/week.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Performance conditional.

characteristics.name: Faster Developer
characteristics.effect: Earn +15% Player XP from all eligible sources. Dev-trait promotion challenge checks occur 50% more often until the player reaches X-Factor. Does not guarantee promotion; the challenge still must be completed.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Directly accelerates both ratings growth and access to development promotions, so it consumes half the build.

characteristics.name: Team Player
characteristics.effect: Team XP functionality is unlocked from Season 1. The player may convert his earned Player XP to Team XP at the normal 4:3 rate even before reaching his personal ceiling. XP already spent on teammates cannot be reclaimed.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Creates roster-wide value years earlier than normal.

characteristics.name: Great Negotiator
characteristics.effect: All REC Coin contract offers are increased by 20% after the normal contract-value calculation. Applies to Contracts II and III; Rookie Contract remains draft-slot based unless league configuration enables rookie negotiation bonuses.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Meaningful recurring economy bonus.

characteristics.name: Known Commodity
characteristics.effect: For Contracts II and III, the player's performance component can never produce an offer below the 'Elite' salary band. The contract engine values him as an established ceiling-level asset even after a poor contract window.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Removes most downside risk from the career economy.

characteristics.name: Competitive Drive
characteristics.effect: Completing at least 2 of the week's 3 weekly challenges gives the completed challenges' points a +5% bonus.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Requires performance rather than granting passive ratings.

characteristics.name: Film Junkie
characteristics.effect: Future AWR upgrades cost 20% less Player XP. Defensive players also receive 20% cheaper PRC upgrades. Does not change IQ-test results.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Permanent discount on highly valuable mental attributes.

characteristics.name: Generational Ceiling
characteristics.effect: Starting development trait is Star rather than Normal. The player is eligible for future Superstar/X-Factor promotion challenges through performance. No direct ratings are added.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: A major career-long ceiling advantage.

characteristics.name: Complete Package
characteristics.effect: ALL attributes cost 5% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Broad, unconditional discount across every rating, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 2, requires owning 2 Tier 1 perks first.

characteristics.name: Self-Made
characteristics.effect: Unlocks a direct Player-XP purchase that forces YOUR next development-trait promotion. The commissioner still replicates the trait in Madden.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: The single biggest lever in the career economy, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires any Tier 2 perk first.

characteristics.name: Personnel Chief
characteristics.effect: Unlocks the Trade Center for this franchise after the perk is purchased from the Progression Tree.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Opens player movement that is otherwise locked in Rise to Immortality, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Spotlight
characteristics.effect: Earn +10% Player XP from all eligible sources.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Permanent earn-rate bump on top of Origins perks, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 3.

characteristics.name: Pocket Architect
characteristics.effect: THP, SAC and MAC each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Core pocket passer identity; opens the Precision Passer branch. Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Clutch Gene
characteristics.effect: MAC and DAC cost 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Precision Passer identity; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Pocket Architect.

characteristics.name: Immortal Arm
characteristics.effect: THP, SAC, MAC and DAC each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Precision Passer capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Clutch Gene.

characteristics.name: Film Room Commander
characteristics.effect: AWR costs 15% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Single premium mental rating; opens the Field General branch. Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Total Command
characteristics.effect: AWR costs an additional 10% less Player XP; DAC costs 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Field General identity into pre-snap accuracy; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Film Room Commander.

characteristics.name: Field General
characteristics.effect: AWR, DAC and MAC each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Field General capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Total Command.

characteristics.name: Cannon Arm
characteristics.effect: THP costs 12% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Raw arm strength beyond Origins' Born With an Arm; opens the Gunslinger branch. Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Deep Strike
characteristics.effect: DAC costs 12% less and THP an additional 6% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Gunslinger identity toward vertical shots; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Cannon Arm.

characteristics.name: Gunslinger
characteristics.effect: THP and DAC each cost 15% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Gunslinger capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Deep Strike.

characteristics.name: Dual-Threat Engine
characteristics.effect: SPD, ACC and BCV each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Designed for mobile QBs; opens the Dual Threat branch. Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Off-Script
characteristics.effect: BSK and TOR cost 10% less; TUP costs 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Dual Threat identity into improvisation off-platform; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Dual-Threat Engine.

characteristics.name: Dual Threat
characteristics.effect: CAR, JKM and BCV each cost 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Dual Threat capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Off-Script.
